response.overview: When Oh Geum-dong, a Korean expatriate living in Hong Kong, is found mysteriously murdered at his home, Maria Kim appears at his funeral and uses her charm to captivate Chairman Oh's son, Geum-sik. Unknown to him, Maria Kim is a highly trained operative belonging to a spy ring led by Philip Kang, the head of North Korean espionage operations in the Hong Kong district. Enter a mysterious man known only as Mister Zero (O), who steps in to thwart Maria Kim as she closes in on the late chairman's son. Mister Zero boldly foils the ring's ruthless scheme to extort wealthy Korean expatriates to raise funds under Kim Il-sung's orders, fighting brilliantly to protect the local Korean community.
response.title: 미스터 오(O)
